snippet.title: [OUTDATED] Notmads | Trailer | Steam Next Fest 2026
snippet.description:
🚀 WATCH LAST TRAILER: https://youtu.be/a_igU9ZFd_o
🌐 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938100/Notmads/
👉 Play the Notmads demo now on Steam during Steam Next Fest 2026.
🌟 Wishlist and follow the game on Steam.

Notmads is an open-world action RPG where you build your home on the back of a living beast. Fight, craft, grow stronger, and explore a sealed island filled with danger and strange magic.

The demo includes the opening of the game, early main quests, beast companion progression, building systems, the Magical Beam resource mechanic, and online co-op (up to 5 players).

Visit the Steam page for full details, additional screenshots, and updates.
